window_note: Primary-source policy and trade events used to complement price-only reconstruction. market_date is the first market session used on the chart; actual_event_date remains authoritative.

events.title: U.S. imposes a minimum-import-price program and 15% tariff on polysilicon derivatives
events.evidence: The White House announced a Section 232 program covering polysilicon imports and a 15% ad valorem tariff on downstream derivative products.
events.transmission: Trade protection → solar and semiconductor input costs → U.S. supply-chain capex and China-linked exporters
events.confirmation: Implementation details raise landed costs or trigger supplier relocation and retaliation.
events.invalidation: Broad exemptions or delayed implementation materially reduce the effective trade barrier.
events.source_title: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Bolsters National Security and Strengthens U.S. Supply Chains by Imposing Tariffs on Polysilicon and its Derivatives

events.title: China applies countermeasures to six U.S. entities linked to Xinjiang-related sanctions
events.evidence: China's Ministry of Commerce announced transaction and cooperation prohibitions involving six U.S. entities; the measures took effect immediately.
events.transmission: Sanctions response → bilateral compliance risk → technology and supply-chain friction
events.confirmation: Additional entity listings or broader restrictions extend beyond the named organizations.
events.invalidation: No expansion follows and commercial exposure remains limited to the named entities.
events.source_title: China announces countermeasures against six US entities

events.title: U.S. invokes Section 232 to adjust imports of unmanned aircraft systems and components
events.evidence: A presidential proclamation found UAS and component imports threatened U.S. national security and directed measures to adjust imports.
events.transmission: Import restrictions → drone supply-chain repricing → domestic production incentives and foreign supplier risk
events.confirmation: Commerce implementation materially restricts foreign-origin UAS or components.
events.invalidation: Exemptions and implementation scope leave existing supply chains largely unchanged.
events.source_title: Adjusting Imports of Unmanned Aircraft Systems and Unmanned Aircraft Systems Components into the United States

events.title: China's state-asset regulator advances a central-SOE 6G industry program
events.evidence: SASAC convened 31 central enterprises, released 6G scenario co-creation tasks and called for breakthroughs in core devices, platforms and commercialization.
events.transmission: State industrial coordination → 6G R&D and capex → telecom equipment, semiconductors and infrastructure demand
events.confirmation: Named SOEs publish funded projects, procurement plans or commercialization milestones.
events.invalidation: The program remains aspirational without budgets, tenders or implementation milestones.
events.source_name: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission
events.source_title: 国务院国资委召开中央企业6G未来产业推进会

events.title: Beijing E-Town issues the 2026–2028 AI4Chip industrial action plan
events.evidence: The official plan sets 20 tasks for applying AI across chip design, manufacturing, packaging, equipment, materials and the supporting ecosystem.
events.transmission: Local policy support → EDA, equipment, advanced packaging and memory R&D → China semiconductor capex
events.confirmation: Funding, model/computing vouchers and named demonstration projects are awarded to companies.
events.invalidation: Targets are not followed by funded projects or measurable adoption milestones.
events.source_title: “AI4Chip”人工智能赋能集成电路产业跨越式发展行动计划（2026-2028）

events.title: China outlines a five-year industrial-upgrading roadmap centered on AI, advanced manufacturing and NEVs
events.evidence: At a State Council Information Office briefing, officials said China had formulated nearly 200 key AI standards and planned 500 zero-carbon factories while optimizing NEV policy.
events.transmission: National industrial roadmap → manufacturing standards and investment → AI, robotics, EV and clean-industry supply chains
events.confirmation: Ministries publish funded implementation plans, standards and sector-specific targets.
events.invalidation: Implementation lacks budgets, timetables or measurable sector deployment.
events.source_title: China unveils roadmap for AI, NEV industrial upgrading
